TRADEMARK LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Trademark License Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of May 5, 2026 between Sablewood Provisions Company, a Vermont corporation ("Licensor"), and Northgate Retail Partners LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Licensee").

1. Licensed Marks. Licensor owns the trademarks SABLEWOOD and the Sablewood tree logo, U.S. Registration Nos. 5,912,447 and 6,204,881 (the "Licensed Marks").

2. Grant. Licensor grants Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-bearing license to use the Licensed Marks solely in connection with the manufacture, marketing, and sale of packaged shelf-stable soups (the "Licensed Products") in the United States and Canada (the "Territory") during the Term.

3. Quality Standards. Licensee shall manufacture and sell the Licensed Products in accordance with the quality standards attached as Schedule 1, which Licensor may update on sixty (60) days' notice. The Licensed Products shall be at least equal in quality to the samples approved by Licensor under Section 4.

4. Approval and Inspection. Before first commercial use, Licensee shall submit samples of each Licensed Product and of all packaging, labels, and advertising bearing the Licensed Marks for Licensor's written approval, not to be unreasonably withheld. Licensor may inspect Licensee's manufacturing facilities twice per calendar year on reasonable notice, and may request production samples at any time.

5. Ownership and Goodwill. Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns the Licensed Marks and that all use of the Licensed Marks, and all goodwill arising from that use, inures solely to Licensor's benefit. Licensee shall not challenge Licensor's ownership or the validity of the Licensed Marks.

6. Use Requirements. Licensee shall use the Licensed Marks only in the form and manner Licensor specifies, and shall include the notice "SABLEWOOD® is a registered trademark of Sablewood Provisions Company, used under license" on all packaging.

7. Royalty. Licensee shall pay Licensor a royalty of four percent (4%) of Net Sales of Licensed Products, payable within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter, with a statement of Net Sales. Licensor may audit Licensee's records once per year on thirty (30) days' notice.

8. Term and Termination. The Term begins on the date of this Agreement and continues for three (3) years, renewing for successive one-year terms unless either party gives ninety (90) days' notice of non-renewal. Licensor may terminate immediately if Licensee fails to cure a quality breach within thirty (30) days of notice.

9. Effect of Termination. On termination or expiration, Licensee shall immediately cease all use of the Licensed Marks, except that Licensee may sell off existing inventory for ninety (90) days, and shall destroy or deliver to Licensor all packaging and advertising bearing the Licensed Marks.

10. Indemnification. Licensee shall indemnify and hold harmless Licensor from any third-party claim arising out of the Licensed Products, including product liability and Licensee's breach of this Agreement. Licensor shall indemnify Licensee against any claim that use of the Licensed Marks as permitted here infringes a third party's trademark rights.

11. Limitation of Liability. Except for the indemnity obligations and Licensee's payment obligations, neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, and each party's aggregate liability is capped at the royalties paid in the twelve months before the claim.

12. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
